Arnold_Dumbbell_Press: Turn the palms out as you press.
Bench_Dips: Elbows back, push through your palms.
Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row: Pull elbows back, squeeze your shoulder blades.
Cable_Chest_Press: Squeeze your chest, slow on the return.
Cable_Crossover: Hug the cables, squeeze your chest together.
Cable_Rear_Delt_Fly: Arms wide, squeeze the rear shoulders.
Cable_Rope_Overhead_Triceps_Extension: Elbows by your head, reach up tall.
Calf_Press_On_The_Leg_Press_Machine: Full stretch, push through the big toe.
Close-Grip_Front_Lat_Pulldown: Pull the bar to your upper chest.
Concentration_Curls: Elbow still, squeeze the bicep at top.
Cross_Body_Hammer_Curl: Thumbs up, curl across your body.
Dumbbell_Bench_Press: Squeeze your chest, slow on the way down.
Dumbbell_Bicep_Curl: Elbows pinned, curl with the biceps only.
Dumbbell_Flyes: Wide arc, feel the chest stretch.
Dumbbell_Incline_Row: Chest on the pad, elbows back.
Dumbbell_Rear_Lunge: Step back, drop the back knee.
Dumbbell_Seated_One-Leg_Calf_Raise: Full stretch, pause at the top.
Dumbbell_Shoulder_Press: Press straight up, brace your core.
Dumbbell_Squat: Chest up, sit back, drive up.
Dumbbell_Step_Ups: Push through the top leg only.
Face_Pull: Pull to your face, elbows high.
Flat_Bench_Cable_Flyes: Wide arc, hug the cables together.
Front_Dumbbell_Raise: No swing, lift to eye level.
Goblet_Squat: Chest up, sit down between your knees.
Hammer_Curls: Thumbs up, elbows quiet, slow down.
Incline_Dumbbell_Curl: Arms hang back, feel the long stretch.
Incline_Dumbbell_Flyes: Wide arc, feel the upper chest.
Incline_Dumbbell_Press: Upper chest drives it, slow lowering.
Incline_Push-Up: Body straight, chest to the bench.
Leg_Extensions: Squeeze the quads hard at the top.
Leg_Press: Control the lowering, push through heels.
Lying_Dumbbell_Tricep_Extension: Upper arms still, bend only the elbows.
Lying_Leg_Curls: Hips down, curl with your hamstrings.
One-Arm_Dumbbell_Row: Elbow to hip, squeeze your back.
Pushups: Body straight, chest to the floor.
Reverse_Flyes: Lead with elbows, squeeze rear shoulders.
Seated_Bent-Over_Rear_Delt_Raise: Lead with elbows, squeeze rear shoulders.
Seated_Cable_Rows: Chest tall, pull elbows behind you.
Seated_Dumbbell_Curl: Sit tall, elbows still, curl up.
Seated_Leg_Curl: Hips down, curl heels under you.
Seated_One-arm_Cable_Pulley_Rows: Chest tall, elbow back past your side.
Single_Leg_Glute_Bridge: Drive through the heel, squeeze glutes.
Split_Squat_with_Dumbbells: Front heel down, drop straight down.
Standing_Biceps_Cable_Curl: Elbows pinned, squeeze at the top.
Standing_Calf_Raises: Full stretch down, pause at the top.
Standing_Dumbbell_Calf_Raise: Full stretch down, pause at the top.
Standing_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extension: Elbows in, stretch deep behind your head.
Stiff-Legged_Dumbbell_Deadlift: Hips back, feel the hamstring stretch.
Straight-Arm_Pulldown: Arms long, sweep the bar to thighs.
Tricep_Dumbbell_Kickback: Upper arm still, kick back and squeeze.
Triceps_Pushdown: Elbows pinned, lock out and squeeze.
Triceps_Pushdown_-_Rope_Attachment: Elbows pinned, spread the rope at bottom.
Underhand_Cable_Pulldowns: Palms up, pull elbows to your sides.
Wide-Grip_Lat_Pulldown: Pull elbows down, chest up to bar.
